notes.subject: history_culture
notes.why_in_news: Over 10,000 devotees observed the 350th martyrdom day of Guru Tegh Bahadur in Hyderabad, highlighting communal harmony and religious freedom.
notes.fact_box: Over 10,000 devotees gathered at NTR Stadium in Hyderabad to observe the 350th martyrdom day of Guru Tegh Bahadur. The event featured prayers, hymns, and speeches by international preachers. The event also took place in Delhi with a light and laser show at the Red Fort.

prelims_pointers.text: Guru Tegh Bahadur was the ninth Sikh Guru and is revered as 'Hind Di Chadar'.
Over 10,000 devotees attended the event in Hyderabad.
The event was jointly organised by the management committee of gurudwara in Sitaphalmandi and major Sikh gurudwaras across Telangana.

notes.mains_question: Discuss the significance of the 350th martyrdom day of Guru Tegh Bahadur and its implications for communal harmony and religious freedom in India.
mains_dimensions: Role of gurudwaras and international participation
